results.title: Inside Bradley Square Mall's Rise and Reset in Cleveland, TN
results.snippet: Bradley Square Mall in Cleveland, TN, opened in 1991 with four major anchors and a diamond plan design. After multiple sales, closures, and an $18 million renovation, it now operates as a smaller hybrid center with Belk, Dunham's Sports, and AMC.
